item.title: Thursday Poem
item.description: Latin class Alphabetical seating. Peterson, Nils. Desk behind – Plummer, Patience. Amo, Amas, Amat. Pageboy bob. Brown eyes. Complexion – adolescent. No words between us. Her eyes burned holes into my back. Too great a gulf. I’d skipped a grade, she an older woman. I did not know who I was until she taught me…
